segments.name: Semiconductor substrates
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and distributes compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers and raw materials for chip, optoelectronic and solar cell makers.
segments.evidence: We operate in one segment for the design, development, manufacture and distribution of high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrates and sale of raw materials integral to these substrates.

revenueModel.text: Customers worldwide buy substrate wafers and raw materials from the company, which also uses some raw materials internally.
revenueModel.evidence: We use these pBN crucibles in our own ingot growth processes and they are also sold in the open market to other companies.

changes.text: In 2023 the company divested its equity investment in a PRC joint venture.
changes.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2023, we divested our equity investment in a PRC joint venture.
